description:
The image depicts a stop sign situated at the intersection of Andrews Street and another street, likely Northeast.

In the foreground, the stop sign is prominently displayed on a wooden pole, accompanied by a green street sign bearing the name "ANDREWS ST NE" installed above it. The sign features a red octagonal shape with white lettering, clearly indicating its purpose.

In the background, a building with a light blue exterior and white roof is visible, with power lines running along the top of the structure
